init.title: Destination checks and transcript storage
init.description: With local only on, HA uses server STT or TTS only when health reports local_only on and a local destination for that part. If a check is unsatisfactory, HA uses the fallback. HA does not use an older server without these fields. HA also checks fallback destinations and speaker events. These configured-destination checks are not a firewall. These checks do not include the conversation agent.

speaker_destination.title: The server reported a cloud speaker destination
speaker_destination.description: HA received a cloud speaker result with the local-only option on. Check the server local_only setting. HA cannot stop the server request. The transcript did not change.

invalid_stored_state.title: Invalid stored turn data
invalid_stored_state.description: The integration dropped invalid stored entries. Valid entries stay available. Check HA storage and restart the integration after the storage check. No transcript or token is in this issue.

event_stream_unavailable.title: Satellite event subscription cannot continue
event_stream_unavailable.description: The event subscription for {satellite} has repeated failures. Check the server event stream and HA storage. The integration retries with a maximum 30 s interval. It does not skip a refused event.

fallback_tts_unavailable.title: Fallback TTS entity unavailable
fallback_tts_unavailable.description: Select an available entity-backed standard TTS engine. Legacy provider names cannot supply this fallback.

server_unavailable.title: assist-live server unavailable
server_unavailable.description: Check the server URL, access token, and server status. Standard engines supply fallback speech while the server is unavailable.

shared_pipeline.title: Satellites share an assist-live pipeline
shared_pipeline.description: Select a different assist-live pipeline for each satellite. Shared pipelines cannot identify the correct satellite for each turn. See the setup instructions.
